gate_1_causal.rule: at each candidate moment, threshold = the 75th percentile of every candidate score observed STRICTLY BEFORE that moment, pooled across tickers, updated chronologically
gate_1_causal.warmup_note: warmup candidates pass gate 1 by default and are flagged. The share is reported per policy in T3 so the two regimes are never blended silently.
gate_1_causal.threshold_drift_note: the causal threshold moves as observations accumulate. Its range is reported because a rule whose level drifts is a different rule from a fixed one.

gate_1_v0_style_for_contrast.note: v0's non-causal threshold, recomputed on THIS population. Reported so the causal fix can be told apart from the population fix.
